introduction: Video excerpt from the "Napoleon (Part 3) - The Decline (1812 - 1821)" video : https://youtu.be/VfDk
lead_intro: The Congress of Vienna played a crucial role in reshaping Europe post-Napoleonic Wars. Let's test your knowledge on this historical event!

quiz.question: Which country mainly became Congress Poland in a personal union with the Tsar of Russia?
quiz.explanation: The Duchy of Warsaw mainly became Congress Poland in a personal union with the Tsar of Russia.

quiz.question: What happened to the Confederation of the Rhine after the Congress of Vienna?
quiz.explanation: The Confederation of the Rhine became the German Confederation after the Congress of Vienna.

quiz.question: Which country recovered many lost territories after the Congress of Vienna?
quiz.explanation: Austria recovered many lost territories after the Congress of Vienna.

quiz.question: Which country's neutrality was recognized by all after the Congress of Vienna?
quiz.explanation: Switzerland's neutrality was recognized by all after the Congress of Vienna.

quiz.question: What was the main goal of the victors who met in Vienna for several months after the Napoleonic Wars?
choices: Redraw the new borders of the continent and establish a long-term peace plan
quiz.answer: Redraw the new borders of the continent and establish a long-term peace plan
quiz.explanation: The victors met in Vienna to redraw the new borders of the continent and establish a long-term peace plan after the Napoleonic Wars.
